x: DECEMBER 6th 1980 - WIMBLEDON - COLTS 2½ MILE CHAMPIONSHIP 1.Adam Horton 19.17; 2.K.Sexton 19.28; 3.J.Pink 20.32.
Adam Horton with 100% attendance throughout the season always in first 3 scoring places, second in the Club Championship and second in the Points Scheme.

Left 1st in Colts Points Competition- Gary McGarren Middle 2nd placed Colt - Adam Horton with 3rd placer Justin Caines in the distance. Right First placed in the Boys Points Competition was John Neillis.
Not to be outdone the 'B string' runners showed consistent form to nail the Bronze in the Herne Hill League, largely from the efforts of Matthew Smith, Adam Horton and Robert Mann.
Adam Horton finished second overall in the Surrey League and made the major contribution in lifting that trophy, Matthew Smith was always present, always completing a team.
